falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern relied on volatility compression and orderly consolidation; sustained VIX spike above 35 indicates systemic stress and forced liquidation, invalidating the controlled bottom thesis

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 (August 2024 swing low) on daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Pattern match to bottom_2024_aug requires holding the structural low; breaking below 4,150 confirms this is not a similar bottom formation but rather a breakdown to lower lows

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 60bps from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggests moderate complacency, not panic; a violent flight-to-quality rally in bonds of this magnitude signals recession/credit event, contradicting the soft-landing bottom scenario embedded in the pattern

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
